name: basic-auth
title: HTTP Basic route auth
description: Replace vercelOidc()/placeholderAuth() with HTTP Basic, for agents that run off Vercel.
docs: Set EVESTACK_AUTH_USER and EVESTACK_AUTH_PASSWORD. Requests whose Host is a literal loopback name still need no credentials, so `eve dev` keeps working; the file wraps eve's localDev() in a stricter host check because eve 0.29.5 matches `/^127./` unanchored and any `*.localhost`, which lets a hostile DNS name skip auth entirely. eve fails closed, so without these set, non-loopback traffic gets a 401 — which is the intended behavior, not a bug.
